description:
My tour of Berlin is very different than the usual Politically correct BS. Actually, think of this as the Politically incorrect tour of Berlin, so feel free to bring along your favorite rude jokes when joining us. It will be full of bad language and bad taste jokes-while paying respect where it is due. No snowflakes allowed!

Our exploration will involve memorials, monuments and graves, along with churches and parks. We will discuss a mix of history, current events, local cuisine, the best spots for a cold German beer by the city center of Berlin. Be prepared to be socially active.
Other things to note
The tour is meant for adults, 18 or older. Each guide will be identified with a small yellow flag and our name!
hostdescription:
I'm a tour guide in 4 cities around Europe. My tour style is informative yet untraditional and alternative. I like to believe that the tours are a walking comedy show, but you'll have to join us and confirm this!

As fellow traveler myself, I created the experience I would enjoy when visiting a new city - a fun, uncensored look at history!
locationDescription: Traditional is overrated, I add a kick of madness and history that truly fits Berlin's reputation. We walk by all the places you are aiming to visit and some suggestions of the "to do's" in Berlin.

reviews.text: Great informal tour. Kai was super relaxed and friendly and also shared tips on other places to visit. I hadn’t been to Berlin before so I enjoyed seeing the major sights with a really lovely group of people.

This wasn’t a bad tour but definitely not a 5 star experience in our opinion. We felt like the stories and jokes were super forced and overall not too engaging from a history perspective. This was essentially a super broad history tour of a few spots with some F words, crude jokes, and obscure stories mixed in.

Fun tour, included the major spots I wanted to visit Brandenburg, memorial to murdered Jews, Reichstag building and more. Lots of walking. They literally call themselves “Rude Bastards” so if you get offended at foul language pick a different tour. Lots of humor and jokes, be able to laugh at yourself and not uptight and you will have a great time. Arthur was serious when it was warranted and knew the art of balancing humor and tact.
Arthur was great 😊 the tour was fun and informative and me and my partner really enjoyed it! We would definitely recommend to others.

If you’re coming to Berlin, you want to take this tour. Kai hits all the main spots you already want to go to and he knows so much about the city’s history and has an amazing way of storytelling. He’s funny and knowledgeable which is perfect for a history tour.

What a fun tour! Cole has a vast knowledge of Berlin and guided us through the city while joking around all the time and insulting us (the funny way) - it’s a rude tour! 😝It was a nice experience for us as Germans to be part of this English spoken city tour with all the other foreigners who where with us. Definitely recommend! We even went to a bar in Kreuzberg afterwards with some of the people we got to know during the tour!

This tour is exactly as described. It is a fun, informative and occasionally rude walk with just right amount of history. It's a great way to dip your toes into the history of Berlin while meeting new people and sharing some drinks along the way.
Excellent tour. Loved every minute of it. Thanks Arthur, a great evening. If you come to Berlin and have doubts... don't think, just book it!

Kai is a great guide. He's fun and has a lot of charisma. I was able to listen to them all the time without me thinking. He has made the otherwise dry German history much more digestible in a suitable location. But also spoke respectfully when needed. I might have liked a little more 'Rudeness', but I'm super satisfied and warmly recommend everyone to try the tour too. :)
Tour was a lot of fun. Highly recommend taking any tours with Kai. He also helped us get directions at the end of our tour to get back to our hotel. So good!

JACK was superb! A torrential downpour, multiple protest groups across the city and police barricades on every second street (yep, it was a particularly happening day in Berlin) - but absolutely nothing dampened Jack’s enthusiasm throughout the tour! She was an trooper and really brought the historic past of this city to life. Definitely a fun way to look around and learn :) p.s: we did an easy 10,000 steps - so make sure your shoes are the right ones!
You won’t be disappointed. I had 2 days in Berlin and this was totally worth experiencing. Our host was Arthur and he was terrific at keeping the whole group entertained.

Such a worthwhile experience! One of my favourite walking tours and I have done plenty across the world. Our host, Cole, was super engaging and super knowledgeable. You could tell he loves Berlin, the history of the place, the culture and meeting new people. He made us feel comfortable at the start of the tour and we, as a group, got over the initial awkwardness quickly. The rest of the walk was filled with core history, funny personal anecdotes, mind scratching nuggets of information about Berlin. It left me wanting to explore Berlin even more, which to me is the ultimate takeaway from a walking tour. Be prepared to walk fast and a few kilometres. Also you have to love the kind of humour this tour has to offer so stay away if you are offended easily. I will say this - at no point did I find Cole to be disrespectful or distastefully inappropriate. The only thing I was left wanting more is history of Berlin but I understand that it has to be at a level enjoyed by everyone. The tour was a wonderful package of solid information (I did look some of them up to confirm after the tour), funny banter, and taking in the sights of a beautiful fall evening in Berlin.

Jack was an amazing tour guide! The tour was a great experience. I loved the comedy, I was laughing the entire time. I did this on my
first day in Berlin and loved it because we visited most sites I wanted to see on my trip.
JACK IS GREAT. She was animated, funny, informative and welcomed questions! The tour was well paced and it was really nice to talk to other travelers in the group as well.
Great tour, very informative and well presented. I was pretty jet lagged the day I went, but Kai’s manner of presenting the information made it fun and accessible.

Such a refreshing tour compared to the somewhat monotonous history tours I normally expect. The tour covered lots of landmarks and it was definitely not dull, I was constantly laughing. Would recommend taking it during your first days in town, since Kai provided us with many ideas what more to see and do in Berlin.

Excellent tour. Do this in Berlin. Kai was a wonderful host who pays close attention to everyone and is absolutely hysterical. Come for the energy and non-PC jokes, stay for the cool facts about Berlin and leave with a lot of historical knowledge!
It was an amazing experience! We went through TOODA the history of Berlin in a dignified, friendly and funny way! Without leaving aside the seriousness where it is required and respect at all times!

This was a great walking tour! The host is animated and less “rude” than animated. Kai was incredibly kind and made sure to connect with every guest and ask questions about where they’re from. We saw a sampling of all history from mid/late 1700s to present. Overall a decent and affordable tour!

Kai had amazing energy, funny dad/raunchy jokes- his storytelling was top-of-the-line and humor really offset some of the heavy history. We had an ample break amid interesting, thorough stops at so many highlights.

Highly recommend this tour to get a sense of the city and the history. Kai was personable and kept us interested in the material the entire time. I did this on the first day of my trip which was great to identify spots I want to come visit and spend more time in.

Had an incredible and amazing time with Mr. Cabbage. He made walking ~8000 steps across the heart of Berlin amazing fun. He was very considerate of the different people in the tour, very responsive to questions are we went through and had a smile on his face the entire time! 11/10 would recommend!

Such a great tour. Rather than a boring tour where the guide rattles off all the dates of every stone rebuilt, this tour was fun, eccentric and hilarious all while our guide Cole really knew his stuff if you did want to know all the historic dates. The whole concept was great to loosen up and really get to know a foreign city.
Cole was great!! So inviting, absolutely hilarious, and never a dull moment! We learned so much and felt very included in all aspects on the tour. A must in Berlin!!

This was the best way to spend an afternoon in Berlin. Arthur was hilarious and gave us a really detailed, thoughtful tour. It's crazy how much easier it is to digest and retain information when it's told in an amusing, and engaging, way. We saw a ton of sights and had a bunch of small details pointed out to us that we wouldn't have noticed otherwise- it really made our time in Berlin so much more special.
Really fun way to discover the city, Kai mixed fun anecdotes with historical facts and took us on a big tour of some of the most emblematic parts of central Berlin. Would recommend!

Cole the cabbage was a fantastic, engaging story teller who more than exceeded our expectations. We felt like we seeing the real Berlin through the eyes of a friend you would never bring home to your mother. Highly recommend!

Excellent tour. Great information and history provided in an easy to understand and entertaining manner. Kai gets down to just the right level of detail throughout the tour. Great jokes and humor all in the spirit of good fun. Topped off with a great list of recommendations for the remainder of our trip.
I definitely recommend this tour.
Great tour! Highly recommend for those coming to Berlin that want a unique tour experience and are not offended by political incorrectness or vulgar language.

Super interesting way of getting to know the culture and history of Berlin. Was entertaining and easy to digest. Love the storytelling!! would recommend to people visiting berlin for the first time and wanting to know more about the city in a more chill and relaxed manner

Jack is very funny, and very informative when you ask her additional questions about the city.

We had some rain in the middle and had a spontaneous visit to a local currywurst shop. The improvisation was super fun, too!

I did this tour on my first day in Berlin, and by covering a lot of ground both literally and figuratively, it made the remaining stay of my Berlin trip extra insightful. Highly recommend!
This experience was great! Totally unlike any walking tour I’ve ever had. Our tour guide was so funny, knowledgeable, and personable. I highly recommend this tour to anyone that’s visiting Berlin!
Brilliant experience with Kai. He was very knowledgeable and a great storyteller. I highly recommend this tour to anyone looking for an engaging way to learn more about Berlin!

We had a great time and felt like it was the best way we could understand many historical and societal factors that have made Berlin what it is today. Kai was a excellent guide - funny, earnest, and knowledgeable. We would recommend to any friends visiting Berlin.
Kai tells stories with good humor and takes you though all the hotspots so you can check them off your bucket lists. A great starting point for new arrivals in the city who don’t know where to start!

Arthur provides a quick wit twist to your typical tour guide experience. It’s so refreshing because these days, it’s important to capture and keep your audience attention. He does this through crude humor, rarely known facts and trivia, and asks his audience to participate. We had a small group of 6 so it was very personable. A great 3.5 hour intro to Germany history with visual tour and a few breaks for bathrooms and beer. Highly recommend!

Absolutely loved the walking tour. The session was not only informative but also rude as we wanted it to be. Our guide was brilliant who took us through historic Berlin. Going on this walking tour was a highlight of our tour. Would recommend it if you have a bit of thick skin and want to have an unconventional but interesting tour.

Kai was fantastic. He had great energy, was super with history. Awesome overview of history of the area done with one tour. We felt Kai was friendly, knowledgeable, and empathetic towards history. 12/10 would do again.
A fun tour, a little silly but not information overload like some other tours. Nothing was offensive and I had a good time
Great tour with charismatic tour guide - Arthur in our case - who don't focus just on Nazis and Soviets, but elaborate on other major parts of history of Berlin/Germany. Really interesting and fun.
Great! Arthur was very funny and engaging, while also having a great grasp of the history of the area. A really cool way to see Berlin.

First time in Berlin. Our tour guide was Arthur. Incredible story teller, very animated, and very passionate. He took us to places we otherwise would not have gone, and had insights that we wouldn’t find in a regular tour. Strongly recommended.

I was excited to engage however found the delivery of information a bit flat. Lots of walking plenty of detail if you stayed at the front and asked private questions, those at the back missed out on lots.
We had a group of 14 and we’re still expecting more to arrive - way to many.
Our tour guide Jack was super friendly, funny and very knowledgeable about bits of history that I think most people would not have known. I very much enjoyed this tour.

A very different way to experience the history. Lots of swearing and sexual references.. not for children or people who are easily offended. Highly recommend for anyone who likes a little cheekiness in their side of history.

Arthur was a hilarious and awesome host! The tour was entertaining and well-planned! I highly recommend it to anyone visiting Berlin. Do this tour early in your trip so you can capitalize on the awesome recommendations for museums, bars, clubs, etc that you receive after the tour via message. Thank you so much!
This tour was so fun! Definitely a highlight of my Berlin trip. Kai was hilarious and so knowledgeable about the city. It was a great experience!

This was a very fun and informative tour. We met with an ex patriot named Jack instead of Kai. Our group was all American except for one person from Singapore. There was a lot of walking but we learned a lot about the history of Berlin. I won’t ruin it for you but there’s a lot of dirty history. On a whole I would do this trip in any other city based on this experience.

What an amazing experience! Doing this tour with Arthur and listening to all he had to share was just a wonderful and insightful experience. The passion he shows for history is contagious! Would highly recommend it - this is a must-do when in Berlin.
We had a blast!! Kai was to the point, relevant, and entertaining without boring us. Definitely would recommend to anyone visiting Berlin for the first time.

Cole was great guide armed with rude, naughty jokes and warm heart. He know a lot of stories behind Berlin's monuments and historic sites. Ask him anything about Berlin, he will give you great interesting story with humor. I enjoyed walking and talking with him.
If you want to experience Berlin with a Twist this is the tour for you. You will not only learn but you will have a laugh... And a beer or two... Or just... "Wash" off.

it has been a great way to see and learn about some of the city's main spots and stories in such time. very thoughtful, funny and friendly guide who went out of his way to cater a great experience for all group.

This is definitely the tour you want to take! Great value, lot's of interesting history, and if you want to sit back and enjoy you can do that or ask the guide in-depth historical questions, you can do that too!

If you are looking for a fun tour to help get you navigated to Berlin, AVOID this tour. The only typical tourist site you will visit is the Brandenburg gate. All other 'sites' are on the side of a random street or park. The stories are not specifically related to the history of Berlin or Germany. It's as if someone went though a history book and thought 'how could we make this funny'. The stories relied heavily on homophobia and jokes felt very forced.

Our tour guide Jack couldn't answer any basic questions, for example, she wasn't sure if Adolf's underground bunker had a ventilation system and instead made a joke about how many farts would build up. Meanwhile, if you look at the sign 20m away it details a complex ventilation system.

Again, if you're hoping for a funny and 'rude' tour to help you orientate to Berlin & its history, avoid this. If you want to go on a 2-hour walk with ~5 stops with random stories full of dick jokes and homophobia, then enjoy!
Cole was an absolutely incredible guide and made the experience so much fun. Would highly recommend to anyone looking to have a good mix of meeting people and learning about the history of berlín.
The tour was great, we walked around Berlin and learned a lot. Cole has a great sense of humor and has always funny stories.

If you’re going to do a walking tour it must be this one!! We had the pleasure of being hosted by Cole who is hands down the cheekiest and funniest tour guide I’ve had to date. His personality and insane amount of knowledge about the city (currently and historically) made the tour phenomenal. The communication was very good and easy to find the meet up spot as well.

This is one of those annoying tours where they ask for donations at the end. Not as bad as those tours where they take you into a shop to sell you merchandise on the tour but still a bit annoying. It’s also the trash version of tours. It’s sort of like The Jerry Springer of tours. To my surprise, napoleons dick is in a plastic lunch bag in New Jersey. The things you’ll learn on this tour!
Arthur was great, he is the best story teller. Guy had lot of knowledge, he is the true historian and of-course he’s funny too which made the tour even more better.
Kai is hilarious, great historical tour that's easy to listen to. Time flew by. I feel much more oriented to Berlin and the history now.
Arthur was a fantastic tour guide! He’s very passionate about German history and it shows! Arthur is very funny and a great storyteller.

This tour was appropriately irreverent, wonderfully thoughtful, and accidentally educational. The tour guide has a wealth of information about both the history of the city, and things to do (and avoid) when visiting. Every suggestion that was spot-on, from which bars to visit, food to eat, and tourist traps to avoid. I’d recommend taking this tour as the first thing one does upon arriving in Berlin.
the attitude was very good and the narrative too, only that everything dropped a little after a while

The tour guide, Cole, was amazing, great charisma and sense of humour. The whole 3.5 hours went away really quickly. It felt more like a walk around a city with some friends, one of whom just happened to know everything about the city, all the funny stories about the famous places in Berlin. Cole also gave recommendations for restaurants, bars, clubs and museums at the end of the tour. And one last thing, if you're worried about the length of the tour being too much to handle, be sure not to worry because somewhere in the middle of the tour we did stop at a nice place to get a drink, snacks and ice-cream or to use the bathroom of course.
I really recommend this tour for anyone wanting to see all the cool places in Berlin and to have some fun while doing so!

Rude, fun, laugh, yet informative! Our tour guide Cole (aka. Flamingo Gentleman) is super funny and energetic, also shows genuine RESPECT to the past. During the walk/break there's also a lot of conversations going on. Nice tour 🙌

This was an excellent tour with Kai. I did another tour similar to his, but his was with a sense of humor (when it was appropriate) and more friendly. He told great stories and shared interesting histories. I learned a lot. Everyone was free to express their thoughts and feelings. He was knowledgeable and funny. He also provided list of restaurants and other things to do while in Berlin. I recommend this tour for anyone visiting Berlin for the first time (or more.)

Phenomenal and unique tour! 3.5-4 hrs is a long time to be walking around but Kai is an incredibly engaging person and the time flies by. He covers a ton of sites so the tour definitely helps you get grounded in Berlin and seeing some of the popular attractions. This tour is not as "rude" as you might think, Kai is very respectful to the past and the history but will convey it sometimes in a more fun manner. However if you don't like swearing or creative insults then I would not recommend this for you.

This was a different take on the tours I have had. By ther name it self, expect humor and all. Arthur's energy was as high as he was on drugs (just kidding), so as his knowledge with the German history. Excellent! Learned a lot.
Thanks to Cole for visiting Berlin! It's energetic and captivating from start to finish. He tells stories and stories about Berlin with a lot of humor, we had a very pleasant time!
This is an awesome tour! Arthur was an amazing guide - he had extensive German history knowledge, all delivered with a wicked sense of humor! Learnt so much and made some friends 🙌🏾
compelling story, fun, wasted. And I didn't even understand everything Arthur told us (because I don't know English perfectly)!
Kai did a fantastic job of teaching us the history and lore of berlin's rich history! Highly recommend this entertaining, engaging + unique perspective!

Overall, this was an enjoyable walking tour and it was fun that the information was provided in a more relaxed, humorous way with stories that we probably wouldn’t have heard on other tours. The tour lasted a bit under three hours which included a 20 minute break in the middle to grab drinks, snacks, or to use the restroom, so that helped with pacing. However, it then didn’t last the 3.5 hours expected, and there was a lot of walking time that didn’t include the guide talking, so that was a bit disappointing. The humor felt forced at times, but still, the way the information was presented kept everyone engaged and actively listening the entire time. I wouldn’t recommend the tour to anyone who doesn’t appreciate adult humor and cursing, but I am glad we went and would encourage those who are looking for a more unique Berlin history walking tour to try it! P.S. It’s a donation-based tour, so make sure to bring cash with you for your guide!

The tour with Kai was very informative, interesting and fun/funny.
It’s definitely a must if you’d like to get to know Berlin and it’s history with some spice and seriousness where it was required. He also went the extra mile and shared his recommendations of places to visit because there’s only so much we could cover during the tour in this vast city of Berlin. Asante sana Kai!!

Very good tour, full of facts and stories told in a funny way.
In the end Kai also provided a list of recommendations of what we can do in the city and places to visit!
Highly recommend!

The tour is a great introduction to Berlin. The humor and matter of fact nature are not over the top and dialed back in appropriate places to be very respectful when needed. The tour was light and informative with everyone having a lot of fun.
A good way to get your step count up, see some parts of the city that you wouldn’t normally go to and learn some history

Tour was very informative and the guide was very knowledgable. The tour was definitely different than your normal city walking tour and seemed to fit the Berlin vibe pretty well. The tour was pretty long, but packed with info and there are a few breaks for refreshment, etc.

cole was such an entertaining and fun guide! he had so many interesting stories to tell about each place we visited and really made this tour funny, memorable, and insightful. i would definitely recommend this to anyone who is looking for a tour in berlin :)

This tour is absolutely a must and the price is a steal. Kai brought so much energy to our group, was very personable, obviously loves what he does, and most importantly - is very knowledgeable. Better than your ordinary tour because it brings a sense of humor to it. Don’t forget to tip your guide!
Cole is great tour guide. He did a awesome job in tuning a ordinary tour into a refreshing version to get to know more about Berlin and just having fun during a tour.

Kai was awesome! Super personable!
We took our two teenage boys and this may be the first time they actually stayed engaged for a whole tour! We got tons of information in a fun/ theatrical way. Def recommend!

Arthur was great from the start and all the way until the finish he has some energy levels I can tell you. We covered a lot of ground on the tour that included some of the most historical sites of the city.

Arthur was our group’s host. i was amazed by how knowledgeable Arthur was. the experience didn't feel scripted at all because of how fluid Arthur was with his presentation. and he made it really fun and quite rude!

Amazing tour, personalised recommendations and expert knowledge! Super fun and friendly. Ask Cole any questions and he'll know and answer you, you can tell he has a huge archive in his brain which he built up over many years ahhaha. Thanks so much!

Informative walk centering around the brandenberger tor area. Cole was very knowledgable! Not sure the "rude bastards" theme is for me, but some people got a real kick out of it. Felt a bit forced and it was hard to chat with the other tourists. Still went some interesting places, learned some things, and got suggestions at the end – thanks for that!
An entertaining way to take in all the history of Berlin. I enjoyed the quicker pace and humor. I am traveling with youth and it really held their attention. I would recommend.

Kai was the best guide! He uses fun and personalized ways to assist you in seeing so many staple sights in Berlin! The group was small which allowed us all to get to know each other! Would do this again in a heartbeat!

It was an A-MA-ZING experience! Kai was great at making history come to life and explaining how modern Berlin was shaped! The flow of the tour was great as it was broken into two halves with a good break in between to rest the legs and grab a nibble

However, if you're easily put of by snide comments or can't take a joke then this might not be the tour for you (see definition for "butthurt")
Cole Reulbach was the most entertaining host I’ve had. He is hilarious and has superb storytelling skills, overall a great tour and a great time.
Arthur was a fantastic guide. We only had one day in Berlin and we learned so much during our tour. Arthur was funny, thoughtful, and respectful throughout the entire tour!
Great tour with Arthur, passionate and interesting, and eager to take us through the dramatic history of Germany and Berlin, both good and bad.
That was an interesting walking tour! A lot of stories, interesting storytelling and a beautiful explanations around the most important things of the city! Thank you!!

Who would have thought that at 67years old with bad feet and temperatures exceeding 90f that I Momma Cherri would have walked nearly 5 miles in the heat which was at times painful resulting in one of the best experiences ever.
Kai is a natural born story teller. He kept us glued to his every word. For the first time ever I believe I now understand German history. I loved his approach. making us all laugh, smile and hang on to the next riveting story. He made sure we were all comfortable and pointed us to the shade, although even there it was super hot. I cant wait to visit another city where he and his team will bring history alive.

Arthur, our guide, was fantastic! He was engaging and funny but also incredibly knowledgeable. He explained German history by weaving several threads on culture, religion, and governance throughout his discussion at different stops. I left the tour wanting to learn more, so you could say he was inspiring!

It was great. Arthur is funny and has a knack for storytelling. He explained historical events with a modern twist which lent a uniqueness to this particular tour over other walking tours I have taken.
What I felt that could be improved is the pacing. At times he spoke too fast and wanted to cover quite a lot which didn't allow participation from the attendees.
Jack was a great tour guide. Informed, entertaining, and nice. I wasn’t sure about the 3.5 hours at first, but it really did fly by.

Good tour. While in Berlin attractions are pretty spread out and it’s impossible to cover most things in a single tour, Kai’s tour does help to highlight a couple of key things in the city and provide a good orientation for future travel. Story telling was nice also and host kept us engaged throughout. Would recommend.
We had an amazing tour with Arthur. He spoke about Berlin with so much passion and knowledge and kept our attention for the whole tour. A great way to explore the city.
I missed the first time in few minutes and attended next day. The tour is quite informative that you won’t know from book or other travel agency

Cole was a great host, he really kept every guest engaged with personal stories tailored to their needs. Can highly recommend the time goes by really fast and you get a good summary about the history while also getting a more fun local perspective.

This is the perfect tour for anyone who is looking to see the sights in Berlin and have fun while doing it. Kai is very friendly and makes everyone feel included - he provides interesting information about each stop on the tour, seamlessly working his sense of humor into it and giving us all a good laugh. Highly recommend!
Cole was terrific! Easy to tell that he loves what he does. He was knowledgeable, funny, considerate of all guests and made sure we all had a great experience. Highly recommended
he has a lot of knowledge about Berlin's history and knows how to explain it in a funny way. I could learn a lot and have a good time.

Arthur was our tour guide for the afternoon. He was great fun and anything he didn't know wasn't worth knowing. Despite it being my third time in Berlin, I learned so much more. He made it relatable by talking like I was talking to a mate and made history funny, exciting and to the point
Kai was an amazing storyteller and ensured each guest felt comfortable. I thought 3.5 hrs was a a tad long but it went by so quickly. Will definitely recommend this experience.
A very fun, shrimp and different tour to learn about the curiosities of Berlin's most typical attractions.
Arthur and his friends will provide you stories in funny way that helps you to remember very interesting history about Berlin. Also they give you great recommendations about secret places in Berlin.

All tours should be so lively and informative. Cole is an energetic story teller with a great passion for history. It was a very hot day and he took care that we were in the shade and had sufficient stops. 3 hours went by really fast with his unique delivery of historical events. When in Berlin, do this tour and ask for Cole.

Kai is extremely charismatic and fun to listen to he keeps you on your toes whilst relaying som very good and interesting information about Berlin making the history of the city somewhat less dark to take in

If you’re looking for a comprehensive tour(covers basically all of the major tourist locations including reichstag and checkpoint Charlie) at a reasonable price you’d be hard pressed to beat, check it out. The focus here is also historical, not on vulgarity so give it a try

Kai was fun and extremely knowledgeable. He was very thoughtful making sure we had shade and asked several times if we had any questions, if he was talking to fast, or if we needed anything. Felt like a walk with friends and the time flew by! BRING GOOD SHOES! HIGHLY RECOMMEND!
Arthur was amazing, great tour with very interesting details about the history and culture of the city, that stay with you long after the tour is done.
It has been a fascinating and magical experience, very entertaining, energetic and has far exceeded our expectations. An endearing character
This tour was awesome. Kai is funny, friendly, and knows what he‘s talking about. He also gives good advice on spots to visit after the tour. Do this!
Really excellent for those looking for a different style of Berlin tour. Our guide Cole was highly engaging, knowledgeable and humorous. Would strongly recommend.
Absolutely fantastic! Arthur was brilliant and knew exactly what he was talking about, he was engaging and we learnt loads. Highly, highly recommend.
Thanks Arthur for this captivating visit of Berlin! I learned a lot and about a lot of little details that I would have missed without you!

I warmly recommend the Rude Bastards Berlin tour, with Kai.
Very entertaining, lots of information presented in a funny but also professional manner!
Extremely great value, super chill casual vibes, honest down to earth recommendations and historical explanation, we were in a small group so that was nice.
We had a great time on the tour with Louis! He is super knowledgeable, chatty and funny - he kept things interesting and light hearted at all times. :)

Best way to get to immerse yourself in so much history. Louis was a great story teller, knows a lot of facts (is an actual historian) and it's very fun to be with. I will totally repeat it and recommend. Thanks for everything!
Arthur was an amazing host! I would recommend this to anyone that would like to learn more about the infamous landmarks of Berlin
The tour was amazing! Not conventional but definitely better than any tour I’ve done before, Arthur managed to cram in so much information while still being fun. 10/10 would do again.
Kai was an awesome guide, historian & cool dude. A few laughs along the way in what was a great look into a dark German history! Highly recommended!!!

Kai is an extremely fun guy and quite knowledgeable about German history broadly and Berlin history specifically.

I’ve gone on a lot of tours throughout Europe and this was no doubt one of my favorites!

"Honest Bastards" would have been a better description. A very nice airy tour. Louis was a super guide who was nice to tell and was open to questions. I can recommend this tour to everyone if you don't want a standard guide!

Had an awesome time with Cole, his flamingo and the other visitors! I felt so comfortable with everyone, didn't hesitate to ask any stupid questions I had in my mind during the tour, which is rare for occasions like this. Had some great laughs, got some truly interesting info about the city and its urban history. Totally worth it!!

This is the best tour I've been on. Cole, our tour guide, is very knowledgeable and provided an insight into the history and significance of the places we visited. Most of all, unlike most other tours, Cole kept everyone entertained throughout and also provided recommendations on what to do for my remaining days in Berlin.
Cole was hilarious and full of interesting facts you wouldn't normally hear about Berlin! Would definitely recommend this tour if you aren't a snowflake.
